items.title: Eddie Miller and Pete Fountain Interview, 1970-01-09
items.q: That was a great influence on me, and a lot of kids, like the Dukes of Dixieland, and, you know, Frank and Fred Asunto.

ctx.x: Tony Almerico had that music room down in Wall Street.
Right, right, the Parisian room. That was a great influence on me, and a lot of kids, like the Dukes of Dixieland, and, you know, Frank and Fred Asunto.
What do you think about that, Eddie, about the influence between white and black musicians?
